The palette is explicitly set off as a topic before the self-contained action fragment. This avoids forcing the object's insertion inside Shan တူပ်ႉဝႆႉ, and keeps arrow direction and action together. Current canonical Shan arrow fragments are absent; the independently accepted C left fragment and an explicitly proposed right fragment are evaluated separately, without claiming they are integrated. Existing E target is superseded only by this separate proposal; no active runtime approval or credit claimed.
